Recorded from one interactive Claude Code 2.1.322 session: `events.jsonl` is
what the bridge's hook script appended, `transcript.jsonl` is the session
transcript reduced to the fields the bridge reads. Paths were rewritten to
`/work`; nothing else was changed. The session covers a Bash and an Edit call
behind permission prompts, a tool error, a background task that reports back
on its own, an Escape interrupt, and a refused permission prompt.
